summary: Regression + new-feature testing for GoGreat iteration 2 (Leads Dashboard, non-blocking email side-effect, provisional health score, testimonials, footer socials, contact testid dedup). Backend: 12/12 pytest passed including two new tests asserting POST /api/health-scan and POST /api/contact return in <5s (email fire-and-forget). Frontend: full end-to-end verified via Playwright — Home testimonials-section (3 'Sample —' cards), no rupee prices in services/process, 'FREE' appears only once (step 01); Footer social links present with correct hrefs and hello@gogreat.in shown; Contact form testids unique (1 each), submission -> contact-success; Health Scan 8-step flow submits and shows scan-success + scan-score '94/100'; /gg-leads-dashboard loads without navbar/footer, tab-scans/tab-contacts render with counts, freshly submitted TEST_Playwright lead visible in both lists, leads-refresh works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'); migrate to lifespan handler (non-blocking).

asyncio.create_task(send_lead_email(...)) references aren't retained; unhandled task exceptions are only logged inside send_lead_email (which catches Exception broadly). Acceptable for fire-and-forget but consider a background task registry for graceful shutdown.
computeScore in HealthScan.jsx uses simplistic regex heuristics — score can vary widely on same intent (e.g. 'no' vs 'nothing'); document as provisional (already labelled).
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_-prefixed records (TEST_User, TEST_Min, TEST_Contact, TEST_Fast, TEST_Playwright) in mongo collections health_scans and contacts via API + UI during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite (12 tests) at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all CRUD, validation, list ordering, and non-blocking email latency (<5s). Frontend confirmed with Playwright end-to-end. Dashboard is on hidden route /gg-leads-dashboard with no Layout wrapper. Email proxy is fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task; failures logged but never surfaced. All previously reported issues from iteration_1 (duplicate contact-phone/contact-email testids) are fixed.
